name: Galadriel
subtitle: Keeper of Nenya
game_text:
At the start of each turn, heal Galadriel.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Exert Galadriel to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is a Shadow card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength −3.
flavor_text: “‘In Dwimordene, in Lórien / More fair than thoughts of Mortal Men.’”
